findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
Task listener on "create" (class "com.acme.Notify") runs code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:taskListeners (eventType="creating").

findings.message: Camunda 8 has no task listener event like "timeout".
findings.suggestion: Model the timeout with a timer boundary event.
